theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (ψ : Euclid N → Euclid P) (V : Set (Euclid N)), MeasurableSet M → LipschitzWith L f → IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ∃ (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid N)) (F : ℕ → Euclid N → ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F k) ∧ MeasurableSet (Y k) ∧ IsCompact (closure (Y k)) ∧ closure (Y k) ⊆ V ∧ ψ '' Y k ⊆ M ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y k, f (ψ y) = F k y) ∧ μHE[N] ((M ∩ ψ '' V) \ ⋃ k, ψ '' Y k) = 0
